_about: Header names in the WebinarJam registrants export (Registrants, Export, Export all registrants). Matching is case-insensitive: an exact match wins, otherwise the first header that contains an alias. The real export headers are not documented: after the first real export, put its exact headers first in each list. 'entered_is' says how to read the entry column: 'offset' (time from session start, like 00:03:20), 'clock' (time of day, like 11:03 AM or 2026-11-12 11:03:20) or 'auto' (a date or AM/PM means clock, anything else means offset). 'minutes_is' says how to read two-part times like 05:30: 'hms' (hours:minutes), 'ms' (minutes:seconds) or 'minutes' (plain numbers only). It is empty on purpose: the import refuses two-part values until someone has looked at a real export and set it. Three-part values (00:52:10) are always hours:minutes:seconds.
